bagPolicy.summary: For the health and safety of guests, Mohegan Sun Arena prohibits several types of bags including backpacks and diaper bags. Increased screening procedures may delay entry, so early arrival is encouraged.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Mohegan Sun offers over 13,000 parking spaces with options for reserved parking through Riverview Reserved Parking. Valet service is available 24/7, and electric vehicle charging stations are located in multiple garages.

rideshare.note: Guests utilizing ride share services (Uber/Lyft/Taxi) should utilize the Highland Park Blvd. entrance and inform the parking attendants upon arrival. Parking attendants will direct you to the drop off/pick up location

concessions.note: Mohegan Sun Arena offers a variety of food and drink options, with numerous lounges and bars available throughout the venue. Special offerings include the VISTA Lounge at Wombi Rock and the Avalon nightclub, providing a vibrant nightlife experience.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Mohegan Sun Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Mohegan Sun Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Mohegan Sun Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Mohegan Sun Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
